title: VooPoo Argus Empty Replacement Pods 2ml - 2pk
description: The new Argus P1 15W pod kit from Voopoo is a premium vape device built for incredible flavour and performance while being super-compact and easy to transport. This pocket-sized vape is versatile enough to offer a variety of MTL (mouth-to-lung) and DTL (direct-to-lung) vaping styles, with the aid of Voopoo’s ITO coils which are available in a variety of resistances to let you tailor your vape just the way you want. Replacing the coils is simple thanks to their ‘Plug-n-Play’ design. The leak-resistant 2ml pods attach to the Argus P1 device with strong magnets and feature a 4-hole inlet for better, smoother airflow, while Voopoo’s ITO atomisation technology ensures you get the best flavour from your chosen coil and e-liquid. To refill, simply detach the silicon seal plug to reveal the fill port
